latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the reviser stage and completed the same native Goal. The binding guard passed.

The proposal covers the original brief, disposes of all 20 released-plan clauses, and records decisions on C-01 through C-04. It keeps the engine choice conditional and incorporates the FTS5 contentless update/delete and version constraints confirmed in the [SQLite documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/fts5.html). The structured source map records source conditions, access times, and applicability.
